question: Why is generative design software used in launch vehicle structures?

options.text: To reduce weight while retaining strength

solution:
The correct answer is __**To reduce weight while retaining strength**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Generative design software optimizes structures** by using advanced algorithms to create lightweight designs that retain the required strength and durability.
 
• It employs artificial intelligence and machine learning to explore thousands of design permutations and identify the most efficient configuration for launch vehicle structures.
 
• This software helps reduce the weight of critical aerospace
